title: 原地深蹲 15 个
tip: 膝盖对准脚尖、臀部往后坐，唤醒久坐睡死的臀肌
tip_en: Track knees over toes, sit hips back, and wake up sleepy glutes.

title: 麦肯基俯卧轻撑
tip: 手肘撑稳微微抬头，骨盆贴地放松，给腰椎反向减压
tip_en: Prop on elbows, keep hips relaxed on the floor, decompress lower back.

title: 站起来接水 + 远眺
tip: 离开椅子走两步，顺便让眼睛睫状肌松一口气
tip_en: Walk away from your desk and relax eye focus on a distant point.

title: 靠墙静蹲
tip: 后背贴实墙面、小腿垂直地面，稳住核心不塌腰
tip_en: Press your back flat against the wall, shins vertical, brace your core.

title: 站立扩胸 + 绕肩
tip: 双手背后相扣轻轻拉开胸腔，对抗低头圆肩
tip_en: Clasp hands behind your back and roll shoulders open against hunching.

title: 踮脚提踵 25 次
tip: 站直慢起慢落，促进下肢血液回流
tip_en: Rise slowly onto your toes and lower smoothly to boost leg circulation.
